hooks.command: file="$TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; if echo "$file" | grep -qiE '(package-lock\.json|\.env|deploy/|public/vendors/)'; then echo 'BLOCKED: Protected file — edit manually'; exit 1; fi

file="$TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; if echo "$file" | grep -qiE '\.js$'; then npx eslint --no-warn-ignored --max-warnings 0 "$file" 2>&1 | head -30; elif echo "$file" | grep -qiE '\.css$'; then npx stylelint "$file" 2>&1 | head -30; fi
